description: Browse unclaimed drafts from active campaigns the connected user can earn from — the public network AND the private spaces (distribution squads) the user is a member of, in one list, newest first. To see ONE space, pass space_id: never conclude a space has no drafts from the unfiltered list, because its drafts can be past the first page. An item from a space carries `campaign.space` (id, name): say which space it is from, and that it pays Stars inside that space. Each item is a real social post plus a pre-drafted text, with the `platform` it lives on (X, Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn) and an `actionType` — `reply` (post it as a reply under the target post) or `quote` (X only: post it as a QUOTE of the target post, the text above the quoted post, from the user's own account). Free, read-only. Flow: the user picks an opportunity → call hold_opportunity on it (a 10-minute hold so no one else posts the same draft; one hold at a time) → the user edits and approves the text and posts it from their own account → call submit_participation with the URL of what they posted. Drafts other members are holding are not listed; the user's own live hold carries `heldUntil`. The user needs that platform's handle linked on their ProductClank profile for the reward to be attributable. Likes and reposts are proved with a screenshot and stay in the web app (app.productclank.com/feed).

space_id.description: Only this private space's drafts (space_id from join_space, or campaign.space.id on an item). Use it whenever the user asks about ONE space or squad: the unfiltered list is newest first across everything, so a space's older drafts can be past the first page.
